meta.source: Salesforce Flex Credits Rate Card (effective June 17, 2026)
meta.warning: Flex Credits are a SEPARATE, newer billing model from the Credit-Based Consumption (Data Services Credits) model modeled elsewhere in this app - only orgs purchasing/renewing after Feb 24, 2026 can be on Flex Credits, and existing orgs stay on Data Services Credits unless they switch. These are two different currencies with no stated conversion rate between them - do not compare totals across the two calculators directly. No $/credit USD rate is published for Flex Credits - it is set per Order Form, so USD cost here requires the user's own rate.
meta.note: phase fields below are this app's own best-fit categorization for consistent grouping/coloring with the rest of the app - Salesforce's rate card does not itself group these by phase.
